context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 144 verified live transcription feature. Key findings: 1) All backend endpoints work correctly (STT status, transcribe-base64, live-transcript save/get), 2) Host-only validation works for transcript save (non-hosts get 403), 3) WebinarLiveRoom has CC toggle visible in control bar, 4) useLiveTranscription hook captures audio and sends to Whisper API, 5) Caption overlay bar conditionally renders when captions exist, 6) All 3 recordings are local (no cloud recordings with completed transcription - so AI Notes buttons not visible which is expected behavior). WebRTC and media features work but show expected 'Media error: NotFoundError' in headless testing.
